bifrost: springboard/src/shell/screentime/ (usage.rs, config.rs, shield.rs, page.rs, chart.rs), springboard/src/shell/settings.rs; no SDK module
summary: Apple's framework is a parent-controls API for web-usage reporting, web-history deletion and child-restriction queries, and it does nothing on visionOS. BifrOSt has no web-usage reporting and no web-history deletion API. Its shell has a Screen Time feature (per-app usage, daily app limits, Downtime, a Time Limit shield) that is not exposed to apps through any SDK API.

features.apple: STWebpageController: url, urlIsBlocked, urlIsPlayingVideo, urlIsPictureInPicture, suppressUsageRecording, setBundleIdentifier(_:), profileIdentifier
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (theme-23, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The browser keeps visits for its own History menu. Nothing reports web usage to a Screen Time store, and no block check for URLs exists.

The restriction rule and the observer's change reports are tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs. Built 2026-10-17: ConfigurationObserver::system watches the shell settings file at /var/lib/springboard/screentime.ini (springboard/sdk/src/screen_time.rs; test system_observer test in that file), and the shell rule is checked against the model (springboard/src/shell/screentime/config.rs test the_shield_rule_agrees_with_the_model_rule). Gap: not tested on the VM or Midget, and the query is not yet exposed through the runtime to apps.

features.apple: STWebHistory: init(bundleIdentifier:), init(profileIdentifier:), deleteAllHistory(), deleteHistory(during:), deleteHistory(for:), fetchAllHistory(completionHandler:), fetchHistory(during:completionHandler:)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (w4-screen-time, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No API lets an app or a parent delete or fetch another app's web history by bundle identifier or date range.

features.apple: Not an Apple API; the Screen Time app's usage data (no public API in this framework)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/os_services/usage_record.rs (UsageDay parse, to_text, ranked, add, window_days); springboard/src/shell/screentime/usage.rs (Tracker, one key=value day file per day, 7-day chart history)
features.note: The day file format, ranking, totals and the seven-day window are tested headless, and the shell tracker writes the same keys. Built 2026-10-17: an app reads its own foreground seconds for a day (springboard/sdk/src/screen_usage.rs, own_seconds; tests in that file). It never sees other apps. Gap: no other app usage is exposed, by design.

features.feature: Daily app limits and the Time Limit shield
features.apple: Not in this framework (system Screen Time)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/os_services/time_limits.rs (Policy::block, Policy::set_limit, Policy::grant_ignore, LIMIT_STEPS); springboard/src/shell/screentime/config.rs (LIMIT_STEPS, Config::block, Ignore grants), springboard/src/shell/screentime/shield.rs
features.note: Limit steps from 15 min to 4 h, the used-time threshold, ignore grants and the Settings exemption are tested headless. Gap: the full-screen shield and its passcode stay in the shell, and the model does not draw it.

features.apple: Not in this framework (system Screen Time)
features.note: The daily window that crosses midnight and the always-allowed list are tested headless. Gap: the shell keeps its own Schedule copy, and the Settings page is not yet wired to the model.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/screentime/page.rs, springboard/src/shell/screentime/chart.rs, springboard/src/shell/settings.rs (st_spec and the Screen Time handlers)
features.note: Settings has Screen Time, Downtime, App Limits and Always Allowed pages with a weekly chart. Web usage is not charted, and there is no Content Restrictions page.

gaps: Web-usage and web-history models exist headless (springboard/sdk/src/web_usage.rs, web_history.rs) but no browser reports into them yet, so no visit is recorded on a device.
The web-history store is in memory; the browser that owns it has no persistence yet.
Web-usage data in the Settings chart and no URL block list, so the shield covers apps only.
Limit state is not exposed to apps (only the app's own usage is, by springboard/sdk/src/screen_usage.rs); docs/bifrost-ui.md does not document the module yet.
